items.docs: Returns the status of all BGP peers configured on this Cilium node, including session state, address families negotiated, and routing statistics.

params.name: table_type
params.description: BGP RIB table type (loc-rib or adj-rib-in or adj-rib-out).

params.name: safi
params.description: Subsequent Address Family Identifier (unicast or multicast).

params.name: neighbor
params.description: Filter routes for a specific BGP neighbor address.

items.docs: Returns the BGP routing information base (RIB) for this Cilium node, including routes learned from peers and locally originated routes for pod CIDRs and services.

params.name: router_asn
params.description: Filter policies for a specific BGP router ASN.

items.docs: Returns all BGP route policies configured on this node, used to filter and modify routes exchanged with BGP peers based on prefix lists, community strings, and other BGP attributes.
